share.title: Share from iPhone
share.description: Lets an iOS Shortcut send CSVs from the share sheet straight into your import inbox. The Shortcut needs the upload URL and an access token.
share.createFailed: Could not create the access token.
share.tokenOnce: Token copied. Paste it into the Shortcut now. It will not be shown again.

guide.create: In the Shortcuts app, tap + and name the new shortcut "Send to Ledgerly".
guide.shareSheet: Open its details (ⓘ), turn on "Show in Share Sheet", and under Receive keep only Files.
guide.request: Add the "Get Contents of URL" action: paste the upload URL below, set Method to POST, add the header Authorization with the value "Bearer " followed by your token, and set Request Body to File with Shortcut Input.
guide.open: Optional: add "Show Notification" at the end, so you know the file arrived.
guide.use: From your bank app or Safari, open the CSV, tap Share, then "Send to Ledgerly". Then tap the Ledgerly icon within 10 minutes: it opens on the import with the file ready.
